en: The postcard features vintage black-and-white illustrative scenes of historical buildings and locations in a wooded park setting. Central images include a grand building with many people outside (identified as Ratskeller), a picturesque forest lodge (Walfschlösschen, Bes[itzer] H. Lödner), a bench named Lyra-Bank, and an area marked 'Waldpartie mit Senkkeller, seit 1855'. The text 'Gruß aus Gehrden' (Greetings from Gehrden) is prominent. The reverse side features handwritten German text, an old German postage stamp, and museum information.
